## Original request

Fix shared-store approval latency and redundant remote reads

Original report. Approving an issue takes well over 30 seconds again. Reproduce by approving issue 176 and other pending items, then fix the slowdown. Escalate shared causes beyond approval when supported by evidence.

Observed in this repair. Issues 176 and 181 both approved successfully after remaining pending beyond 30 seconds. Live store refresh diagnostics showed 23 to 29 seconds. Git-backed Coordination storage is named files. Decoding overflow records resolves artifact relocation through separate authoritative Git reads even while a pinned snapshot is open.

Repair in progress. Keep overflow decoding within its exact provider snapshot, including nested Issue snapshots. Keep ordinary reads and mutation authority fresh. Revoke completed read scopes.

Verification. The focused real-Git fixture failed before the fix with five remote head lookups for four overflow records, then passed with one. Check relocation identity, concurrent and detached tasks, fresh peer reads, and write revision guards. Re-test live approval after restarting the idle server. Retain any remaining latency as an open issue rather than claiming the whole delay fixed.
